test_title: PYST 9: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

He must deliver pizza.

options.text: Pizza has to be delivered by him.
Pizza have to be delivered by him.
Pizza must be delivered by him.
Pizza can be delivered by him.

solution:
The correct answer is '**Pizza must be delivered by him.**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in active voice: "He must deliver pizza."
 
• In passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject: "Pizza."
 
• The auxiliary verb "must" remains the same in passive voice.
 
• The main verb "deliver" changes to its past participle form "delivered."
 
• "By him" indicates the doer of the action in passive voice.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Pizza must be delivered by him.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Pizza has to be delivered by him.** - Incorrect, as "has to" is not equivalent to "must."
 
• **Option 2: Pizza have to be delivered by him.** - Incorrect, as "have to" is not equivalent to "must" and "Pizza" is singular, so "has to" is required.
 
• **Option 4: Pizza can be delivered by him.** - Incorrect, as "can" is not equivalent to "must."
